dead_receiver.title: Proxy {name} is offline
dead_receiver.description:
{name} ({where}) has been offline for {age}: it is not relaying Bluetooth to Home Assistant, so things near it are placed by the other proxies or not at all.

Check its power and Wi-Fi. This repair clears itself when it is heard again; ignore the proxy or take it off the plan in Sextant if it is gone for good.

dead_thing.title: {name} has gone quiet
dead_thing.description:
{name} has not been heard for {age}. It was last heard in {where}.{battery}{home}

This repair clears itself when {name} is heard again.
